title: What’s New: Financial Reporting (for Report Users) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Slimmer user interface and internal descriptions
Display title and report layout improvements

features.name: Internal description for audit purposes
features.description: Financial reports now display an internal description field separate from the display title, used for audit purposes.

features.name: Slimmer user interface
features.description: The financial reporting interface has been streamlined with a more compact title display and improved screen space utilization.

features.name: Negative amount format option
features.description: Users can now choose accounting format for displaying negative numbers using parentheses instead of minus signs.
caveats: applies to view, export, and PDF output

features.name: Portrait mode for PDF export
features.description: PDF exports of financial reports can now be generated in portrait mode in addition to the traditional landscape mode.

features.name: Excel layouts
features.description: Users can now create and manage custom Excel layouts for financial reports, allowing templates to be saved and reused. Layouts can be set as default for direct export without re-uploading.
caveats: data tab must be hidden separately

features.name: Default Excel layout
features.description: Financial report users can designate one Excel layout as the default, which will be automatically used when exporting to Excel without requiring re-upload.
caveats: must be set manually on the report
